name: Check a member's share balances
goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator, look up the member by member number, and open their record. The record shows a table of the member's shares. Read the balance of the FIRST share row shown in the table (i.e. the value cell for that specific row's balance -- not a column header, and not the whole table), and separately read that same first share's status (e.g. whether it is OPEN or on HOLD). These are two separate single-cell reads, each naming one declared output.

outputs.name: first_share_balance
outputs.description: Balance of the first share row shown on the member record.

outputs.name: first_share_status
outputs.description: Status (e.g. OPEN or HOLD) of the first share row shown on the member record.

business_outcomes.description: No member record matches the given member number.
